flag.data: data folder: the accounts (accounts.json, holds tokens), the message log (messages.json), the tasks (tasks.json) and -background's log (bridge.log); SYMPHONY_DATA changes the default
flag.web: for development: serve the pages from this folder, so edits show after a reload; without it the built-in pages are used
flag.mod: for development: a mod folder that sessions started from the page get with --plugin-dir, overriding the installed copy; without it the mod installed in Claude Code is used
flag.terminal: ignored since 0.6: sessions started from the page run inside the bridge, and symphony attach <id> shows their terminal (kept so older -autostart entries still start)
flag.open: open the office in the default browser once the bridge is up; when a bridge already runs at -addr, just open its office
flag.autostart: on: start the bridge whenever you log in, with the flags given here, and start it now; off: undo that
flag.background: start the bridge in the background, detached from this terminal and logging to bridge.log in the data folder, and return once it answers
log.listening: symphony bridge {version}: http://{addr}  (office /, approvals /approve; data in {data})
log.already_running: a symphony bridge is already running at {url}
log.open_failed: couldn't open a browser ({reason}); open {url} yourself
log.autostart_on: symphony now starts when you log in ({where}); it's running at {url}
log.autostart_slow: symphony now starts when you log in ({where}), but doesn't answer at {url} yet
log.autostart_off: symphony no longer starts when you log in, and the bridge it started has stopped
log.autostart_off_window: symphony no longer starts when you log in; close the bridge's window to stop it now
log.autostart_none: symphony wasn't set to start when you log in
log.autostart_go_run: -autostart needs the symphony program itself, not go run: download a release, or build it with go build -o symphony ./cmd/bridge
log.background: the symphony bridge runs in the background at {url}; its log: {log}
log.background_failed: the bridge stopped right after starting ({reason}); its log: {log}
log.background_slow: the bridge doesn't answer at {url} yet; its log: {log}
log.launch_off_mod: Starting sessions from the page is off: -mod {dir} is not a mod folder
log.launch_off_claude: Starting sessions from the page is off: {claude} not found
log.launch_on: Sessions started from the page run inside the bridge (nothing opens); symphony attach <id> shows one's terminal
log.mod_missing: mod: {reason}. To start sessions from the page, run: {fix} (no bridge restart needed)
error.mod_check_failed: can't check whether the mod is installed (claude plugin list --json): {detail}
error.mod_not_installed: the symphony-bridge mod is not installed
error.mod_project_scope: the mod is only installed for one project ({scope}); install it at user scope
error.mod_disabled: the mod is installed but disabled
error.account_bad_name: a name needs 1 to 40 characters and no control characters
demo.flag.seconds: how long to run, in seconds; 0 runs until stopped
demo.create_failed: {name}: can't create it (maybe it exists already): {error}
demo.not_enough: not enough demo accounts; delete the old demo accounts and run again
attach.banner: symphony: {name}'s terminal. Ctrl-] or closing this window detaches; the session goes on.
attach.detached: symphony: detached from {name}; the session goes on.
